purpose: Lock Core5 face/body/hair/clothing identity geometry into resolved image generation so rendering cannot collapse them to one attractive anime base.

characters.name: ユイ
characters.faceShape: soft oval with rounded cheeks and non-pointed chin
characters.eyeShape: almond-round, almost level, slightly soft outer corners
characters.brow: medium soft straight brow with weak arch
characters.lashes: small soft upper fan, minimal lower lashes
characters.nose: low-medium bridge with gently rounded tip
characters.hairMass: dark asymmetric hair, one side tuckable behind ear
characters.differenceFromNearest: softer oval, straight brows, neutral eyes, no freckles, mandatory dimples
characters.neutralPoseRead: soft balanced travel silhouette; identity must survive without lantern light or smile

characters.name: アサ
characters.eyeShape: narrow horizontally long upturned fox-like eyes
characters.brow: thin arched brows with short tails
characters.clothingConstruction: cropped asymmetric jacket + sharp diagonal straps
characters.differenceFromNearest: narrower fox eyes, thin arch brows, flat cheeks, less lash volume
characters.neutralPoseRead: compact angular quick-read silhouette; asymmetry comes from construction, not decorative noise

characters.name: ナギ
characters.faceShape: long slim oval with narrow cheek width
characters.lashes: long straight lateral lashes, not curled upward
characters.nose: clearest straight nose bridge among Core5
characters.clothingConstruction: closed collar + long vertical + box geometry
characters.differenceFromNearest: softer long oval, lower brow, thinner fold, more lateral lashes
characters.neutralPoseRead: long closed vertical mass with downward hair weight; beauty-mark candidate is never required for recognition

characters.name: ミチル
characters.faceShape: short broad oval with active cheeks
characters.eyeShape: wide lively cat eyes with visible vertical aperture
characters.brow: thick natural bushy/gejibrow with visible hair flow
characters.lashes: short dense upper lashes plus several visible lower lashes
characters.surfaceIdentity: light freckles / sun marks across nose and cheeks
characters.hairMass: active tied hair with forward/backward motion
characters.clothingConstruction: active layers + map cloth + movement-friendly joints
characters.differenceFromNearest: rounder open cat eyes, bushy brows, freckles, broader grin
characters.neutralPoseRead: mobile outdoor body with active cheek/eyebrow identity; must not become Asa with wider eyes

characters.name: トモリ
characters.eyelid: deep double covered by upper lid
characters.lashes: strong outer upper and lower-corner lashes
characters.nose: medium-high bridge with slightly longer tip
characters.mouth: slightly fuller lower lip and dry smile
characters.surfaceIdentity: small work scar or soot trace
characters.bodyShape: slender mechanic silhouette with practical reach
characters.clothingConstruction: repaired seams + diagonal patchwork + real tool belt
characters.differenceFromNearest: hooded eyes, stronger cheekbone, fuller lower lip, repair traces
characters.neutralPoseRead: slender work-ready reach with hooded-eye/cheekbone identity; tools and goggles cannot substitute for the face
